G02 (#136): draft PR #138 adds `results/G02/` (report, ledger, exact proposed patches). The shooting slope is $s_G=\lambda_G=2b_0(G)$ (= `YM.Gauge.slopeConstant`). It is forced by the reset identity and the path-step bound. The shooting estimate is `eq:running` with the same histories and the same uniformity. A proposed `prop:shoot-public-running` derives `ex-running-input` at $m=N$ with $\sigma=2b_0$. Open: the public-family identification (O2, `YangMills.wilsonFamily`) and owner application of the patches. Claim released; handoff on #136.
